description: Prepared Mars raster layers for the MarsPath web application.
tileScheme: XYZ Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), visualization only; use source COG for measurements.

layers.name: MOLA global elevation color
layers.source: Mars Global Surveyor / MOLA MEGDR product MEGT90N000EB.IMG
layers.notes: Global-scale topography; too coarse for small rocks or local obstacle detection.

layers.name: HiRISE ESP_052869_1660_RED quicklook
layers.coordinateConvention: Planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude. Tile bounds normalized to -180..180 for web map clients.
layers.source: HiRISE ESP_052869_1660_RED.QLOOK.JP2 with matching PDS label ESP_052869_1660_RED.LBL
layers.notes: Single grayscale lossy quicklook image. Footprint was assigned from the matching PDS label bounds; use a full-resolution orthoimage/DTM for precision terrain analysis.
